description.en: Reopens the music saved by SaveBgmHistory, if any: CMND_SND_OPEN_BGM(history_bgm_name), or with _resume true CMND_SND_OPEN_BGM(history_bgm_name, 0, history_bgm_pos) to start where it was. It only opens the track; start it with CMND_SND_PLAY (the handle is not returned, CMND_SND_GET_BGM_SNDID gives it). No shipped script calls it.
true to start from the saved position.

examples.case: Resuming the saved music (not found in script_clean/; invented)
